transcript.content: Hi, it's good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, it's nice to meet you too. Well, I'm here because I'm having a really hard time with my eating lately. 

What really scares me is that once I start eating—especially when I’m alone in the kitchen—it feels like I’ve just stepped aside. I can’t make myself stop. Even though I’m telling myself the whole time, ‘Janet, put it away,’ I just keep going. I feel like I've completely lost control over it, and I just don't know how to fix it on my own.
After these episodes, do you ever make yourself vomit?
No, I don't do that. I've never tried to make myself throw up or anything like that. I just... I just sit there feeling awful about what I've done, but I don't try to get rid of the food.
After these eating episodes, do you ever use laxatives, diuretics, or exercise excessively to try to make up for what you ate?

No, I don't use anything like that. I don't take laxatives or water pills, and I definitely don't exercise to try and work it off. Like I said, I really just sit there feeling bad about it, but I don't do anything to try and undo what I just ate.
Are you currently at a very low body weight for your height?
No, I'm not. I'm actually overweight, which makes sense with how much I've been eating. But no, definitely not at a low weight.
